meta.name: 机器学习领域知识图谱

entities.name: 监督学习
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 利用带标签数据学习输入到输出映射的学习范式

entities.name: 无监督学习
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 从无标签数据中发现结构与模式的范式

entities.name: 半监督学习
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 用少量标签数据与大量无标签数据联合训练的范式

entities.name: 自监督学习
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 从数据自身构造监督信号进行预训练的范式

entities.name: 强化学习
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 智能体与环境交互、依据奖励信号学习策略的范式

entities.name: 集成学习
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 组合多个基学习器以提升泛化能力的范式

entities.name: 深度学习
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 以多层神经网络自动学习层次化特征的范式

entities.name: 迁移学习
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 把源域学到的知识迁移到目标域的范式

entities.name: 分类任务
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 预测样本所属离散类别的任务

entities.name: 回归任务
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 预测连续数值目标的任务

entities.name: 聚类任务
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 按相似度把无标签样本划分为若干簇的任务

entities.name: 降维任务
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 在保留主要信息的前提下压缩特征维度的任务

entities.name: 异常检测任务
entities.label: Concept
entities.aliases: 异常检测|outlier detection|离群点检测
entities.description: 识别与大多数样本显著不同的异常样本的任务

entities.name: 排序任务
entities.label: Concept
entities.aliases: 排序|ltr|learning to rank|推荐排序
entities.description: 按相关性对候选集合进行排序的任务

entities.name: 序列预测任务
entities.label: Concept
entities.aliases: 序列预测|时序预测|sequence prediction
entities.description: 对时序或文本序列做下一时刻预测的任务

entities.name: 过拟合
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 模型在训练集表现好、在测试集泛化差的现象

entities.name: 欠拟合
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 模型容量不足，训练集与测试集表现都差的现象

entities.name: 正则化
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 在损失函数中加入惩罚项以抑制过拟合的方法

entities.name: 梯度下降
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 沿负梯度方向迭代更新参数的优化方法

entities.name: 损失函数
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 衡量预测值与真实值差异、供优化器最小化的函数

entities.name: 核技巧
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 用核函数隐式完成高维映射、避免显式计算内积的技巧

entities.name: 特征工程
entities.label: Concept
entities.aliases: feature engineering|特征选择|特征构造
entities.description: 构造、选择与变换特征以提升模型效果的过程

entities.name: 交叉验证
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 轮换划分训练集与验证集以稳定评估模型的方法

entities.name: 偏差方差权衡
entities.label: Concept
entities.aliases: bias variance|偏差-方差|泛化误差分解
entities.description: 模型误差在偏差与方差之间取得平衡的关系

entities.name: 信息熵
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 度量随机变量不确定性的指标，是决策树划分的依据

entities.name: 最大间隔
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 通过最大化分类间隔提升泛化能力的原理

entities.name: Bagging
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 自助采样并行训练多个基学习器再投票或平均的集成策略

entities.name: Boosting
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 串行训练弱学习器并逐步修正残差的集成策略

entities.name: 注意力机制
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 按相关性动态分配权重的序列建模机制

entities.name: 表示学习
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 自动学习数据有效特征表示的一类方法总称

entities.name: 模型评估
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 用评价指标与验证策略衡量模型性能的过程

entities.name: 超参数调优
entities.label: Concept
entities.aliases: 调参|网格搜索|贝叶斯优化
entities.description: 搜索最优超参数组合以提升模型性能的过程

entities.name: 数据不平衡
entities.label: Concept
entities.aliases: 样本不平衡|正负样本不均衡|imbalance
entities.description: 类别样本分布严重不均、导致模型偏向多数类的问题

entities.name: 维度灾难
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 高维空间中样本稀疏、距离失效导致模型性能下降的现象

entities.name: 序贯决策任务
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 在连续交互中依据长期回报选择动作的任务

entities.name: 机器学习
entities.label: Concept
entities.description: 研究如何让计算机从数据中自动学习规律并持续改进性能的学科

entities.name: 线性假设
entities.label: Concept
entities.aliases: 线性关系假设|线性模型
entities.description: 假设目标值是输入特征的线性组合、误差独立同分布的建模前提

entities.name: Sigmoid函数
entities.label: Concept
entities.aliases: sigmoid|S型函数|对数几率函数|激活函数
entities.description: 把任意实数压缩到0~1区间的S形函数，用于把线性输出转成概率

entities.name: 线性回归
entities.label: Algorithm
entities.description: 用线性函数拟合连续目标值的最小二乘回归算法

entities.name: 逻辑回归
entities.label: Algorithm
entities.aliases: logistic regression|对数几率回归|逻辑斯蒂回归
entities.description: 用Sigmoid函数把线性输出映射为类别概率的分类算法

entities.name: 岭回归
entities.label: Algorithm
entities.description: 在线性回归损失中加入L2正则项的回归算法

entities.name: Lasso回归
entities.label: Algorithm
entities.description: 加入L1正则项、可产生稀疏特征的回归算法

entities.name: 决策树
entities.label: Algorithm
entities.description: 依据信息增益等准则递归划分特征空间构建树结构的算法

entities.name: 随机森林
entities.label: Algorithm
entities.description: 用Bagging组合多棵决策树并投票或平均的集成算法

entities.name: 梯度提升树
entities.label: Algorithm
entities.description: 串行拟合损失负梯度的树集成算法

entities.name: XGBoost
entities.label: Algorithm
entities.description: 引入正则项与二阶泰勒展开的高效梯度提升树实现

entities.name: LightGBM
entities.label: Algorithm
entities.description: 采用直方图算法与叶子生长策略的轻量梯度提升树

entities.name: CatBoost
entities.label: Algorithm
entities.description: 原生支持类别特征、使用有序提升的梯度提升树

entities.name: 支持向量机
entities.label: Algorithm

entities.name: K近邻
entities.label: Algorithm

entities.name: 朴素贝叶斯

entities.name: 准确率

entities.description: 预测正确的样本数占总样本数的比例

entities.name: 精确率
entities.label: Metric

entities.name: 召回率
entities.label: Metric
entities.description: 真正为正的样本中被成功预测出来的比例

entities.label: Metric
entities.description: 精确率与召回率的调和平均，兼顾二者平衡

entities.label: Metric
entities.description: ROC曲线下面积，衡量模型对正负样本的排序区分能力

entities.name: PR-AUC
entities.label: Metric

entities.name: 混淆矩阵

entities.name: 平均绝对误差
entities.label: Metric

entities.name: 轮廓系数

entities.name: 调整兰德指数

entities.name: 困惑度

entities.name: BLEU
entities.label: Metric

entities.name: 平均精度均值
